experiments.hypothesis: The 800-pair run is undertrained relative to the verified corpus.

The declared 512-token function prompt budget is below the size of the prompt's own required sections, so raising it should increase reference-validity and Kill@k without changing evaluator semantics.
experiments.reason: Local CPU evidence only. Under section-aware fail-closed compaction at 512 tokens, 388/542 ablation_dev and 583/757 val function records cannot be prompted at all, and only ~1,930 of 5,595 synthetic training records are usable. A sampled scan over the training split gives ~97.2% fit at 768 and ~99.8% at 1024. No GPU comparison has been run, so no budget has been selected.

local_cpu_evidence.method: section-aware compaction attempted per record; no model loaded

experiments.protocol_note: The prompt budget is part of the evaluation scope hash. Results at a new budget are not comparable with V4 numbers produced at 512 unless the V4 adapter is re-evaluated under the same budget.
